# openai_workspace_workload_identity_providers (Data Source)

Beta. List workload identity providers visible in a ChatGPT workspace. The API returns a complete list. Typed summaries omit arbitrary JSON; response_json contains the full results.

Authentication: Set the workspace_admin_api_key provider attribute or OPENAI_WORKSPACE_ADMIN_KEY environment variable for the workspace API audience; with a custom workspace_base_url, set the workspace_admin_api_key provider attribute explicitly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openai_workspace_workload_identity_providers" "example" {
  workspace_id = "workspace_123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the owning ChatGPT workspace.

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) data (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `id` (String) Synthetic data source identifier.
- `response_json` (String) Raw JSON response returned by the OpenAI API.

- `audience` (String) Expected audience claim for the external identity.

- `issuer` (String) issuer
- `max_assertion_lifetime_seconds` (Number) max assertion lifetime seconds
- `name` (String) name
- `owner_id` (String) owner id
- `owner_type` (String) owner type
- `type` (String) Credential type. The API defaults to oidc.
- `updated_at` (Number) updated at
- `verification` (Attributes) Verification settings. Defaults to OIDC discovery. Set type to discovery to clear uploaded keys or a JWKS URI. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--verification))
